data.title: BEM Reports 60% EMV Contactless Growth, Backs Govt Common Ticketing System
data.description: BEM has announced a significant increase in the adoption of EMV Contactless payments, with usage rising by 60% following the full implementation of EMV payment acceptance across the MRT Blue Line and Purple Line.
